scope: Actual arbitrary-length selector matrix reductions, cubic positive-factor log-concavity and outer entropy; quantitative H1 surfaces remain separate

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.entropy_term_le_reference
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {p b τ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ b → 0 < τ → p * Real.log (b / p) ≤ p * Real.log τ + b / τ - p

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.entropy_term_nonneg
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {p b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ b → 0 ≤ p * Real.log (b / p)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_entropy_term
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (p b : Ω → ℝ),
  Measurable p →
    Measurable b →
      (∀ (x : Ω), 0 ≤ p x) →
        (∀ (x : Ω), p x ≤ b x) →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable p μ →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable b μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => p x * Real.log (b x / p x)) μ

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.entropy_term_common_factor
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {c p b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → c * p * Real.log (c * b / (c * p)) = c * (p * Real.log (b / p))

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integral_sum_entropy_le_fixed_scale
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (p b : ι → Ω → ℝ),
  (∀ (a : ι), Measurable (p a)) →
    (∀ (a : ι), Measurable (b a)) →
      (∀ (a : ι) (x : Ω), 0 ≤ p a x) →
        (∀ (a : ι) (x : Ω), p a x ≤ b a x) →
          (∀ (a : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (p a) μ) →
            (∀ (a : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (b a) μ) →
              ∀ {τ : ℝ},
                0 < τ →
                  ∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, p a x * Real.log (b a x / p a x) ∂μ ≤
                    (∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, p a x ∂μ) * Real.log τ + (∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, b a x ∂μ) / τ - ∫ (x : Ω), ∑ a, p a x ∂μ

  (∀ (a : ι), Measurable (p a)) →

      (∀ (a : ι) (x : Ω), 0 ≤ p a x) →

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_selector_projected_reduction
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (α : Fin K → RectangleCLT.Face p) (P : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
  P.transpose = P →
    P * P = P →
      ∀ (β : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
        Measurable β →
          (∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ β x ∧ β x ≤ 1) →
            (∀ (g : Fin r → ℝ), RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v) ≤ β (P.mulVec g)) →
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v)) ≤
                2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorProjection s A v α P +
                    4 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorEntropy s A v α P β -
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorRadialTrace s A v α

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_sum_weighted_selector_reduction
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ)
  (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (α : ι → Fin K → RectangleCLT.Face p) (c : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ c i) →
    ∀ (P : ι → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
      (∀ (i : ι), (P i).transpose = P i) →
        (∀ (i : ι), P i * P i = P i) →
          ∀ (β : ι → RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), Measurable (β i)) →
              (∀ (i : ι) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ β i x ∧ β i x ≤ 1) →
                (∀ (i : ι) (g : Fin r → ℝ),
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s (α i) (A.mulVec g + v) ≤ β i ((P i).mulVec g)) →
                  ∑ i,
                      c i *
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                          (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightedScore (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s (α i) (A.mulVec g + v)) ≤
                    2 * ∑ i, c i * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorProjection s A v (α i) (P i) +
                        4 * ∑ i, c i * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorEntropy s A v (α i) (P i) (β i) -
                      ∑ i, c i * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorRadialTrace s A v (α i)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_positive_selector_logConcave
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (α : Fin K → RectangleCLT.Face p),

          RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec g + v)
